worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.summary: Sprays a ball of clinging foam: the main target takes foam damage, may lose Speed and be left foamed, and the foam spreads along the line to coat the foes ahead. Dense foam is stickier and softer; rapid bubbles are faster and longer ranged but barely cling.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.use.0: Stick to a fast foe and drag its Speed down
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.use.1: Coat the area ahead of the target to set up a teammate
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.use.2: Leave a layer of clinging foam on the target
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.description: The ball of foam strikes the target for %1$s special damage.
The foam has a %1$s block hit radius, travels at %2$s blocks/tick and reaches %3$s blocks.
On a hit, a %1$s chance to lower the target's Speed by %2$s stage(s) as a stat stage that does not recover when the foam ends; either way it is left foamed for about %3$s.

Around the impact point the foam spreads %2$s blocks onward along the line in a 110-degree cone; every other foe in the cone takes %1$s splash damage and is also foamed, but with only 80%% of the main target's slow chance and foam duration.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.dense.on: Dense foam: cling chance +10%, up to 2 stages, foam duration x1.3 and splash radius x1.4; costs foam power x0.82, speed x0.85, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.dense.off: Rapid bubbles: foam power x1.12, speed x1.12 and range +2 blocks; costs cling chance -4% and foam duration x0.8.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the foam power rises to %2$s and the splash radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the foam power rises to %2$s, the cling chance to %3$s and the foam duration to %4$s.
On: cling chance +10%, up to 2 Speed stages, foam duration x1.3 and splash radius x1.4, for pinning a foe down; costs foam power x0.82, speed x0.85, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks. Off (rapid bubbles): foam power x1.12, speed x1.12 and range +2 blocks, at the cost of cling chance -4% and foam duration x0.8.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target moving quickly ranks higher so the foam slows it first; off: all targets score the same.
